title: Afghanistan women defy Taliban ban to pursue their ambitions in secret
html:
Afghanistan women defy Taliban ban to pursue their ambitions in secret

Afghan women had their dreams crushed by the strict Taliban ban, restricting their freedom to pursue their ambitions that do not align with ‘Sharia law’. But they’ve managed to find ways to secretly pursue their passions.
summary: Afghan women risk their lives to pursue their dreams, despite strict Taliban restrictions.
